notes.text:
G — I, root position. Home. The gallop begins: strong-beat
note twice, then a dip to D (5th of G).

D/F# — V, first inversion. Root sacrificed so the bass keeps
the chromatic pair G→F#. Dip note D frozen from last bar:
5th of G becomes root of D.

Am — ii, root position. Pair 2 begins: A→G# is pair 1 (G→F#)
moved up a whole step. Same move, transposed.

E/G# — V/ii. The G# giveaway: out of key, so it's functional —
a secondary dominant aiming at Am. Dip note E shared: 5th of
Am = root of E.
C — IV. E7's promise DEFERRED — it aimed at Am but landed here.

D — V. Fake cadence setup. (Bass gives only D+A; major third
confirmed later in the upper tracks.)

Bdim — iiø/ii. The B–F tritone is in the bass itself —
instability you can hear. Aim at the aimer.
E — V/ii again. ii–V–i in A minor underway: Bdim → E → Am.

Am — the promised target finally lands, four bars late,
with a stronger escort. Tonicization: a real key visit.

F octaves — bVII, borrowed from G minor. No Gm ever sounds:
mixture, not modulation. Also doubles as V of the coming Bb.

Bb octaves — bIII, borrowed. F→Bb is a real V→I inside the
borrowing — the devices nest.

Turnaround: the gallop stops for the first time. Bass walks
D–C–B–A in even quarters, delivering onto G at the loop restart.
Texture change marks the cadence.
